transcript: Pilot: Chennai Ground, Alpha 101, stand 24, information Bravo, request pushback and start. ATC: Alpha 101, pushback approved, face west, start at your discretion.
Pilot: Chennai Ground, Bravo 202, ready to taxi, runway 07, information Charlie. ATC: Bravo 202, taxi to runway 07 via Alpha and Bravo, hold short runway 07.
Pilot: Chennai Tower, Charlie 303, holding short runway 07, ready for departure. ATC: Charlie 303, runway 07, cleared for takeoff, wind 080 degrees 8 knots.
Pilot: Chennai Tower, Delta 404, request landing information. ATC: Delta 404, runway 07 in use, wind 060 degrees 10 knots, cleared to land runway 07.
Pilot: Chennai Approach, Echo 505, descending through 4000 feet for ILS runway 07. ATC: Echo 505, descend 2500 feet, cleared ILS approach runway 07.
Pilot: Chennai Departure, Foxtrot 606, passing 3000 feet, climbing 7000 feet. ATC: Foxtrot 606, radar identified, climb flight level 150.
Pilot: Chennai Center, Golf 707, maintaining flight level 240, request direct waypoint KODAI. ATC: Golf 707, cleared direct KODAI.
Pilot: Chennai Approach, Hotel 808, experiencing moderate turbulence. ATC: Hotel 808, report if unable to maintain altitude; you may descend to 5000 feet.
Pilot: Chennai Approach, India 909, we have weather ahead and request deviation 20 miles left. ATC: India 909, deviation left approved, advise when able to resume route.
Pilot: Chennai Tower, Juliet 110, going around. ATC: Juliet 110, roger, climb to 3000 feet, runway heading, contact approach.
Pilot: Chennai Ground, Kilo 121, request taxi to the maintenance area. ATC: Kilo 121, taxi to maintenance via Charlie, hold short of taxiway Delta.
Pilot: Chennai Tower, Lima 132, bird activity observed near runway 07. ATC: Lima 132, roger, runway inspection vehicle is being dispatched.
Pilot: Chennai Approach, Mike 143, minimum fuel, request priority landing. ATC: Mike 143, roger, priority handling approved, continue approach runway 07.
Pilot: Chennai Tower, November 154, unable takeoff due to a technical warning, remaining on the runway. ATC: November 154, stop and hold position, emergency vehicles are responding.
Pilot: Chennai Ground, Oscar 165, request crossing runway 07 to reach the cargo apron. ATC: Oscar 165, hold short runway 07, crossing clearance will follow.
Pilot: Chennai Tower, Papa 176, request departure delay due to weather. ATC: Papa 176, roger, remain at the holding point and advise when ready.
Pilot: Chennai Approach, Quebec 187, unable assigned altitude due to traffic turbulence, request 1000 feet lower. ATC: Quebec 187, descend and maintain 6000 feet.
Pilot: Chennai Center, Romeo 198, request confirmation of assigned squawk. ATC: Romeo 198, squawk 4261.
Pilot: Chennai Ground, Sierra 209, radio check. ATC: Sierra 209, readability five, loud and clear.
Pilot: Chennai Tower, Tango 210, runway vacated, taxiing to stand 18. ATC: Tango 210, taxi stand 18 via Bravo and Echo.
Pilot: Chennai Approach, Uniform 221, request holding instructions. ATC: Uniform 221, hold at KELAR, inbound course 090, left turns, expect further clearance.
Pilot: Chennai Tower, Victor 232, landing gear indication is abnormal, request go-around and assistance. ATC: Victor 232, go around, climb 3000 feet, emergency services are alerted.
Pilot: Chennai Ground, Whiskey 243, request de-icing before departure. ATC: Whiskey 243, proceed to the designated de-icing area.
Pilot: Chennai Approach, Xray 254, request latest runway wind and visibility. ATC: Xray 254, wind 070 degrees 9 knots, visibility 6 kilometers.
Pilot: Chennai Tower, Yankee 265, ready for departure but cabin door indication remains open. ATC: Yankee 265, hold position and advise when the indication is resolved.
Pilot: Chennai Center, Zulu 276, request higher altitude for fuel efficiency. ATC: Zulu 276, unable higher at present due to traffic, maintain flight level 240.
Pilot: Chennai Approach, Atlas 287, lost communication with company operations but aircraft radios are normal. ATC: Atlas 287, roger, continue on present frequency.
Pilot: Chennai Tower, Beacon 298, medical assistance required after landing for a passenger. ATC: Beacon 298, roger, medical team will meet you at the stand.
Pilot: Chennai Ground, Comet 309, request change of departure runway due to performance limitations. ATC: Comet 309, runway 07 approved, taxi via Alpha.
Pilot: Chennai Approach, Dragon 320, we have an engine indication and request to land as soon as practical. ATC: Dragon 320, roger, priority landing approved, continue runway 07 approach.
